name: Homicidal Repentance
body:
School enchantment; Level bard 2, bloodrager 2, lathspell 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the target with sadness and guilt anytime they harm a target. On a failed Will save, if the target deals damage to another creature, they take a -1 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks, skill checks, and weapon damage rolls for 1d6 rounds. If the target renders a creature unconscious, or kills/destroys them, the penalty is increased to -2 for 2d6 rounds. The conditions do not stack, only the highest penalty is applied and each subsequent penalty instead increases the duration of the highest penalty.
